faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Questions You Might Ask
faq.description: Quick answers on AI image workflows, fit, and asset policy.

items.q: What problem does WebToMind solve now?
items.a: WebToMind now focuses on AI image creation: reference reverse, visual slot combining, image generation and history re-editing in one reproducible workflow.
It fits AI image creators, ecommerce visual teams, social designers and operations teams that need stable batch image output.

items.q: Why use slots instead of writing prompts directly?
items.a: Slots split character, expression, pose, wardrobe, lens, lighting and layout into reusable pieces, making replacement and batch iteration easier.

items.q: Who manages my references and generated images?
items.a: You do. Public assets and private uploads are separated, and private assets are used only under your account.
